meta.title: Kagura Ski Resort
meta.description: 1,845 m summit · 32 courses · 6,000 m longest run — Yuzawa's premier powder and long season. Bus 20–45 min from Echigo-Yuzawa Station; après at onsen town and Ponshu-kan.

transit.title:
Shinkansen + bus
to high-alpine powder.
transit.lead: From JR Joetsu Shinkansen Echigo-Yuzawa Station, route buses reach Mitsumata Station in ~20 minutes and Tashiro Station in ~35 minutes (varies by stop). Ropeways and gondolas climb to 1,845 m for Honshu-class dry powder and a season from late November through late May.
transit.imgAlt: Winter bus on a snowy mountain road — from Echigo-Yuzawa to Kagura

primary.title: Yuzawa's highest-elevation powder
primary.lead: 1,845 m summit · 1,225 m vertical · 6,000 m longest run — 35% ungroomed terrain and high-season-only Goroma (No.5 Romance) lift access to tree runs. Part of Mt. Naeba, linked to Naeba by the Dragon gondola.
primary.imgAlt: High-alpine powder and Minamiuonuma snow panorama at Kagura

secondary.title: Kids free & Tashiro views
secondary.lead: Prince Snow Resorts Kids Free program — elementary school and under ski free all season. Lake Tashiro views on Ariesca course and three linked areas (Kagura, Mitsumata, Tashiro) across a vast snow resort.

onsen.title:
Kaido no Yu &
hidden mountain baths
onsen.lead: From Kaido no Yu beside Mitsumata Station to historic Kaikake Onsen and Shukuba no Yu — recovery after skiing plus a stop at Michi-no-Eki Mitsumata on one loop.
onsen.whisper: Check each facility's official site for day-use hours and availability.
onsen.imgAlt: Snow-view rotenburo — winter baths in Yuzawa

kaido.title: Mitsumata Kaido no Yu

shukuba.title: Futoi Shukuba no Yu
shukuba.lead: 537 Futoi, Mikuni, Yuzawa. Community bath toward Tashiro area. TEL 025-789-2910.

moritaki.title: Chaya Moritaki
moritaki.lead: 357-5 Nishinaka, Yuzawa. Crab suki and udon suki institution near Echigo-Yuzawa Station. TEL 025-784-3600.

ninjin.title: Tonkatsu Ninjintei
ninjin.lead: 497-4 Yuzawa, Yuzawa. Echigo mochi pork and Minamiuonuma Koshihikari rice — fill up before the ride home. TEL 025-785-5727. https://ninjintei.net/

nearbyFood.pairingLead: AM: bus to Mitsumata · powder → noon: Ariesca with Lake Tashiro views → PM: Kaido no Yu → evening: Moritaki or Ninjintei → Ponshu-kan tasting.

powder.title: 1,845 m powder & long season
powder.body: Roughly half the year from late November through late May — Yuzawa's last reliable snow. Thirty-five percent ungroomed; Goroma (No.5 Romance) tree runs are a core-rider pilgrimage in high season.

bus-access.title: Bus 20–45 min from Echigo-Yuzawa
bus-access.body: ~20 min to Mitsumata Station, ~35 min to Tashiro (route bus; varies by stop). ~15 min by car from Yuzawa IC. Ropeway and gondola links reach main Kagura terrain — more transfers, but the snow quality pays off.

yuzawa-apres.title: Powder & local culture loop
yuzawa-apres.body: After skiing: Michi-no-Eki Mitsumata and Kaido no Yu, then bus to Moritaki, Ninjintei, and Ponshu-kan — a sample après line that extends beyond the resort gates.

access.note: Bus ~20–45 min from JR Joetsu Shinkansen Echigo-Yuzawa Station (Mitsumata ~20 min, Tashiro ~35 min; varies by stop). ~15 min / ~8 km from Kan-Etsu Expwy Yuzawa IC to Mitsumata.
